target: W04 / P3 of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001: immutable, referential evidence spine. Receipt bytes -> validated dict with provenance (the only place receipts are schema-validated at runtime), an append-only content-addressed evidence store, FreezeReceipt and FinalityReceipt authoring, and the FROZEN -> UNFREEZE -> REPAIR -> REVALIDATE -> REVIEW_SETTLE -> NEW_FREEZE lifecycle with NO_FINAL_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_BEFORE_FREEZE enforced. Base is the frozen, A1-audited W01 head 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875. No audit invocation, no PR/GitHub access, no merge, no activation.
invariants: MACRO I01-I20 apply; I18: evidence is referential and immutable; downstream projections never become authority. Every store entry is addressed by sha256 of its canonical bytes; writes of an existing address with different bytes raise ImmutabilityViolation; there is no update or delete API.

W04 owns 'bytes -> validated dict + provenance' for every receipt type in schemas/governed_execution/ (AdmissionReceipt, ExecutionBinding v2, WriterCustodyReceipt, FreezeReceipt, FinalityReceipt, AggregateReturnEnvelope, plus SliceValidation/CandidateValidation/Review receipts modelled as ValidationRef records {kind, path, sha256, status}). Validation uses a referencing.Registry built from schemas/governed_execution/*.schema.json at call time; schema files are read-only inputs and are not modified.
W04 does NOT author WriterCustodyReceipt (W03 does) and does NOT compute DispatchQualification (W02 does); it stores and references them. W04 does not import from dispatch/, environment/ or join/.

FreezeReceipt authoring binds exactly: repo identity, base sha, head sha, tree sha, substantive paths (sorted), substantive_path_digest = sha256(newline-joined sorted paths), candidate_digest = sha256 over concatenated 'sha256(blob)\n' per path in sorted order, validation refs (minItems 1), review refs, frozen_at (caller-supplied, not clock), freeze_state FROZEN, no_audit_before_freeze True, authority NONE. Inputs are caller-supplied path->bytes mappings and shas; W04 never runs git.

Lifecycle is a pure state machine over FreezeState values from enums.v1 {FROZEN, UNFROZEN, SUPERSEDED, UNKNOWN} with events UNFREEZE(reason), REPAIR_RECORDED(ref), REVALIDATED(refs), REVIEW_SETTLED(refs), NEW_FREEZE(receipt). Illegal transitions raise IllegalTransition. A FinalityReceipt can only be authored from a FreezeReceipt in state FROZEN whose head_sha equals the audited_head of a supplied AuditReceiptRef; audited_head != finality_head raises SubjectMismatch. Any substantive mutation after FROZEN (a new candidate_digest) forces UNFREEZE before any audit ref can be attached; attaching an audit ref to a non-FROZEN subject raises AuditBeforeFreeze.

FinalityReceipt authored by W04 always carries merge_authorized False, activation_authorized False, authority NONE; steward_readiness is copied from the caller-supplied steward snapshot or UNKNOWN, never computed.
Base commit exactly 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875 in worktree .worktrees/gec-v2-w04 branch feat/gec-v2-w04-evidence-spine-001. Any other base is STOP_WRONG_BASE.

Write surface is exactly commit.allowlist. Forbidden: src/dopemux/governed_execution/__init__.py, tests/unit/governed_execution/__init__.py, sibling prefixes (dispatch/, environment/, join/), schemas/**, .control-tower/**, pyproject.toml, tests/governance/governed_execution/**.
No model audits; no push; no TO/ConPort/dope-memory/GitHub mutation; no placeholders; ASCII only; ruff clean; frozen dataclasses; type hints; one substantive attempt.

pr.body:
## Summary
- W04 of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001, stacked on W01
- receipt bytes -> validated dict + provenance (single runtime validation boundary)
- append-only content-addressed evidence store (ImmutabilityViolation on conflicting rewrite)
- FreezeReceipt / FinalityReceipt authoring; freeze lifecycle state machine; NO_FINAL_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_BEFORE_FREEZE and AUDITED_HEAD == FINALITY_HEAD enforced

MERGE_AUTHORIZED=NO ACTIVATION_AUTHORIZED=NO

requirements: Worktree /Users/hue/code/dopemux-mvp/.worktrees/gec-v2-w04, branch feat/gec-v2-w04-evidence-spine-001, 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875 ancestor of HEAD, clean tree except this packet; tests/governance/governed_execution passes (91).

load_registry(schema_dir) -> referencing.Registry from every *.schema.json (keyed by $id); validate_receipt(kind, raw_bytes, provenance: Provenance(verified_by, verified_at, schema_set_digest)) -> ValidatedReceipt(kind, payload: Mapping, sha256, provenance) or raises ReceiptInvalid(errors sorted by path). kind maps to the schema file name; unknown kind raises.

EvidenceStore(root: Path): put(bytes) -> address (sha256 hex); get(address) -> bytes; put of an existing address with identical bytes is a no-op returning the address; with different bytes raises ImmutabilityViolation (only possible via caller bug since address is content hash, but assert it explicitly by comparing stored bytes); no delete/update methods exist (assert by dir()); ref(address) -> EvidenceRef {path: relative store path, sha256}. Store layout: root/<first2>/<sha256>.

author_freeze_receipt(subject: FreezeSubject(repo_identity, base_sha, head_sha, tree_sha, blobs: Mapping[path, bytes]), validation_refs: Sequence[EvidenceRef], review_refs: Sequence[EvidenceRef], frozen_at: str) -> dict validating against freeze_receipt.v1; digests as specified in invariants; packet_id/macro_id supplied by caller.

FreezeLifecycle(receipt) with .state, .apply(event) returning a new FreezeLifecycle (immutable), legal transitions: FROZEN --UNFREEZE--> UNFROZEN; UNFROZEN --REPAIR_RECORDED--> UNFROZEN; UNFROZEN --REVALIDATED--> UNFROZEN; UNFROZEN --REVIEW_SETTLED--> UNFROZEN; UNFROZEN --NEW_FREEZE(receipt)--> FROZEN (old marked SUPERSEDED via supersedes_freeze_ref); anything else raises IllegalTransition. attach_audit_ref(lifecycle, audit_ref, audited_head) raises AuditBeforeFreeze unless state is FROZEN and audited_head == receipt.head_sha.

author_finality_receipt(freeze_ref, audit_ref: AuditReceiptRef(path, sha256, audited_head, verdict), finality_head, pr_ref, steward_snapshot: str|None, recorded_at) -> dict validating against finality_receipt.v1; raises SubjectMismatch if audited_head != finality_head or != freeze receipt head; merge_authorized False, activation_authorized False, authority NONE always.

test_validate: every valid fixture under tests/governance/governed_execution/fixtures/valid/ (read-only) round-trips through validate_receipt for its kind; every invalid fixture raises ReceiptInvalid; provenance is carried; unknown kind raises.

test_store_immutability: put/get round trip; identical re-put no-op; forged different bytes at same address (monkeypatch hashing) raises ImmutabilityViolation; no delete/update attribute; ref() sha256 equals address.

test_freeze_receipt: authored receipt validates; substantive_path_digest and candidate_digest equal independent hashlib recomputation; path order independence (same set, different input order -> same digests).

test_lifecycle: every legal transition; every illegal transition raises; NEW_FREEZE marks the old receipt SUPERSEDED with supersedes_freeze_ref; attaching an audit ref to UNFROZEN raises AuditBeforeFreeze; attaching with a different audited_head raises.

test_finality_subject_binding: AUDITED_HEAD == FINALITY_HEAD happy path validates; mismatch raises SubjectMismatch; authored receipt always has merge_authorized False and activation_authorized False; steward_readiness None -> UNKNOWN.
